verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Airbyte publishes MCP servers so external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) can connect to Airbyte's data — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Airbyte itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence anywhere in the pack shows Airbyte acting as an MCP client or importing tools from third-party MCP servers.
